ayahOccurrences.text: قُلِ ٱللَّهُمَّ مَٰلِكَ ٱلْمُلْكِ تُؤْتِى ٱلْمُلْكَ مَن تَشَآءُ وَتَنزِعُ ٱلْمُلْكَ مِمَّن تَشَآءُ وَتُعِزُّ مَن تَشَآءُ وَتُذِلُّ مَن تَشَآءُ ۖ بِيَدِكَ ٱلْخَيْرُ ۖ إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ

ayahOccurrences.text: وَلَقَدْ صَدَقَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ وَعْدَهُۥٓ إِذْ تَحُسُّونَهُم بِإِذْنِهِۦ ۖ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا فَشِلْتُمْ وَتَنَٰزَعْتُمْ فِى ٱلْأَمْرِ وَعَصَيْتُم مِّنۢ بَعْدِ مَآ أَرَىٰكُم مَّا تُحِبُّونَ ۚ مِنكُم مَّن يُرِيدُ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَمِنكُم مَّن يُرِيدُ الْآخِرَةَ ۚ ثُمَّ صَرَفَكُمْ صَرَفَكُمْ عَنْهُمْ لِيَبْتَلِيَكُمْ ۖ وَلَقَدْ عَفَا عَنكُمْ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ ذُو فَضْلٍ عَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

ayahOccurrences.text: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا أَطِيعُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُوا۟ ٱلرَّسُولَ وَأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَمْرِ مِنكُمْ ۖ فَإِن تَنَٰزَعْتُمْ فِى شَىْءٍ فَرُدُّوهُ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَٱلرَّسُولِ إِن كُنتُمْ تُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ خَيْرٌ وَأَحْسَنُ تَأْوِيلًا

lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ن/ز/ع   n–z–ʿ to pull out, to strip off, to pull at
; an archer; to incline, to take after (a parent); to walk briskly, to strive; to desire; to exchange, to dispute, controversy.

Of this root, 5 forms occur 20 times in the Qur’an:
نَزَعَ nazaʿa 10 times; يُنَازِعُ yunāziʿ 1 time; تَنَازَعَ tanāzaʿa 7 times; نازِعات nāziʿāt 1 time and نَزَّاعَةٌ nazzāʿatun 1 time.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
نَزَعَ nazaʿa a [v. trans.]

1 to pull out, to take out

(7:108) وَنَزَعَ يَدَهُ فَإِذَا هِيَ بَيْضَاءُ لِلنَّاظِرِينَ and he pulled out his hand and–lo!–it was white for the beholders

2 to remove

(15:47) وَنَزَعْنَا مَا فِى صُدُورِهِمْ مِنْ غِلٍّ and We will remove from their hearts whatever rancour is therein

3 to withdraw, to take away, to abolish

(11:9) وَلَئِنْ أَذَقْنَا الإِنْسَانَ مِنَّا رَحْمَةً ثُمَّ نَزَعْنَاهَا مِنْهُ إِنَّهُ لَيَئُوسٌ كَفُورٌ how desperate and ungrateful man becomes when We let him taste Our mercy and then withdraw it from him

4 to sweep away, to tear away, to uproot

(54:20) تَنْزِعُ النَّاسَ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍ مُنْقَعِرٍ it sweeps people away, as if they were uprooted palm trunks

5 to peel off, to strip off

(7:27) يَنْزِعُ عَنْهُمَا لِبَاسَهُمَا stripping their garments off them

6 to select, to choose, to draw

(28:75) وَنَزَعْنَا مِنْ كُلِّ أُمَّةٍ شَهِيدًا We will choose from every community a witness

7 to pluck out, to root out

(19:69) ثُمَّ لَنَنْزِعَنَّ مِنْ كُلِّ شِيعَةٍ أَيُّهُمْ أَشَدُّ عَلَى الرَّحْمَنِ عِتِيًّا then We will seize out of each group those who were most disobedient towards the Lord of Mercy.

entries.label: ن-ز-ع
entries.definitionHtml:
ن/ز/ع   n–z–ʿ to pull out, to strip off, to pull at
; an archer; to incline, to take after (a parent); to walk briskly, to strive; to desire; to exchange, to dispute, controversy.

Of this root, 5 forms occur 20 times in the Qur’an:
نَزَعَ nazaʿa 10 times; يُنَازِعُ yunāziʿ 1 time; تَنَازَعَ tanāzaʿa 7 times; نازِعات nāziʿāt 1 time and نَزَّاعَةٌ nazzāʿatun 1 time.

entries.label: نَزَعَ
entries.definitionHtml:
نَزَعَ nazaʿa a [v. trans.]

1 to pull out, to take out

(7:108) وَنَزَعَ يَدَهُ فَإِذَا هِيَ بَيْضَاءُ لِلنَّاظِرِينَ and he pulled out his hand and–lo!–it was white for the beholders

2 to remove

(15:47) وَنَزَعْنَا مَا فِى صُدُورِهِمْ مِنْ غِلٍّ and We will remove from their hearts whatever rancour is therein

3 to withdraw, to take away, to abolish

(11:9) وَلَئِنْ أَذَقْنَا الإِنْسَانَ مِنَّا رَحْمَةً ثُمَّ نَزَعْنَاهَا مِنْهُ إِنَّهُ لَيَئُوسٌ كَفُورٌ how desperate and ungrateful man becomes when We let him taste Our mercy and then withdraw it from him

4 to sweep away, to tear away, to uproot

5 to peel off, to strip off

(7:27) يَنْزِعُ عَنْهُمَا لِبَاسَهُمَا stripping their garments off them

6 to select, to choose, to draw

(28:75) وَنَزَعْنَا مِنْ كُلِّ أُمَّةٍ شَهِيدًا We will choose from every community a witness

7 to pluck out, to root out

(19:69) ثُمَّ لَنَنْزِعَنَّ مِنْ كُلِّ شِيعَةٍ أَيُّهُمْ أَشَدُّ عَلَى الرَّحْمَنِ عِتِيًّا then We will seize out of each group those who were most disobedient towards the Lord of Mercy.

entries.label: تَنَازَعَ
entries.definitionHtml:
تَنَازَعَ tanāzaʿa [v. VI] I [intrans.]

1 to be at variance with one another, to fall into dispute with one another

(8:46) وَلاَ تَنَازَعُوا فَتَفْشَلُوا ‏‏and do not dispute [among yourselves], lest you fail

2 to debate, to differ with one another, to disagree

(4:59) فَإِنْ تَنَازَعْتُمْ فِى شَيْءٍ فَرُدُّوهُ إِلَى اللَّهِ وَالرَّسُولِ if you should dispute over something, refer it to God and the Messenger II [trans.]

1 to debate an issue, to discuss

(18:21) إِذْ يَتَنَازَعُونَ بَيْنَهُمْ أَمْرَهُمْ when they discussed their situation among themselves

2 to exchange, to pass [something] around, to share in a friendly manner

(52:23) يَتَنَازَعُونَ فِيهَا كَأْسًا therein, they pass around cups of wine.

entries.label: نَازِعَاتٌ
entries.definitionHtml:
نَازِعَاتٌ nāziʿāt [pl. of fem. act. part. نَازِعَةٌ nāziʿatun] those who strive, those who pull out, those who discard. In the single context in which this word occurs in the Qur’an it is variously interpreted as the stars that rise and set regularly, the charging horses ridden in God’s cause, the archers who pull away in the cause of God, the souls that vie to achieve higher ranks, the angels that tear out the souls of the wicked and others. The context, however, may also be understood to refer to those who by actively seeking God’s pleasure manage to go from ‘lagging behind’ in their worship to being in the vanguard of the pious

(79:1) وَالنَّازِعَاتِ غَرْقًا by those pulling out forcefully; * النَّازِعَاتِ name of Sura 79, Meccan sura, so‐named because of the reference in verse

1 to the ‘Forceful Chargers’.

entries.label: نَزَّاعَةٌ
entries.definitionHtml:
نَزَّاعَةٌ nazzāʿatun [intens. fem. act. part.] one which resolutely tears away, plucks out

(70:16) نَزَّاعَةً لِلشَّوَى stripper of scalps (or, limbs).

entries.label: يُنَازِعُ
entries.definitionHtml:
يُنَازِعُ yunāziʿ [imperf. of v. III trans. نَازِعُ nāzaʿa] to dispute with, to contend with

(22:67) فَلاَ يُنَازِعُنَّكَ فِى الأَمْرِ so do not let them dispute this matter with you.
